pageDecisions.title: Moderation decisions
pageDecisions.lead: Decisions that removed content carried by this page (volunteer mission, job offer, arrival kit resource, reply to a review, event), their reasons and the page's appeals. People who reported are never named. Any signatory of the page can appeal.
pageDecisions.empty: No decision has removed content from this page.
pageDecisions.loadError: The page's decisions could not be loaded.
pageDecisions.lost: You no longer sign for this page: its decisions are no longer available to you.
pageDecisions.unavailableBody: This version does not serve page moderation decisions yet.

system.moderation_decision: A moderation decision has been made.
